notes.title: 1.50 version MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
1. ENGLISH localization has been added.
2. New Action, Fantasy Style, which can be used after successfully blocking, causing a lot of multi-stage damage.
3. Now the Counterattack Style trigs 100% percent when you block enemy's attack.
4. Step Back move is added to the Whirlwind Style.
5. New Magic Weapon "Heaven & Earth Circle", can enhance the Fatansy Style.
6. The difficulty is simplified into three difficulties as follows, Human, Asura, Celestial.
7. Now the combat is more like souls game, and the battle skill tips have been added to the death interface.
8. Boss now drops a higher level of items.
9. Cancelled the interval of blocks, now can use the block more quickly.
10. The Chaos Style and the Whirlwind Style add directional displacement, which can move more flexibly in combat.
11. The damage of reflection spells has been increased.
12. Added a cool down to Counterattack.
13. Crushing now have a high amount of additional damage which is related to the level.
14. The recovery effect of the potions is improved.
15. Players who have played before are recommended to try again. The feel and action design of the current game are greatly improved compared to the original version!


Happy Spring Festival!
-- ShinNing Cloud Studio

notes.title: 1.02 version Update
notes.notes:
1.02 version Update

1. 修复了死亡后有时无法点击复活的BUG。
2. 修复了法宝天赋加点错误的BUG。
3. 修复了 怪物被法宝伤害不会被吸引的BUG。
4. 天赋进行了部分调整，削弱了普通攻击加成，增强了法宝加成。
5. 携带药水增加了数量限制，现在最多能携带10个相同的药水。
6. 现在大药用完后小药会自动装填药水栏。
7. 略微延长了格挡时间，现在更容易格挡怪物的攻击。
8. 略微延长了破招触发时间，现在更容易破解怪物的重攻击。
9. 六耳猕猴的格挡现在附带霸体。
10. 略微增加了难度系数。
11. 游戏内过场tips增加了飞行操作等提示。
12. 现在花果山之巅掉下去10次之后会传送的目的地平台。
